display.purpose: Hero and major editorial statements in Cormorant Garamond.

body.purpose: Product descriptions and storytelling in Montserrat.

motion.name: ease-luxury
motion.purpose: Heavyweight, silky smooth hover zoom and modal transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid Champagne Gold action button for primary luxury CTA and appointment booking.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c59c55; color: #0a0704; border: none; padding: 16px 36px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4aa65; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(10,8,4,0.7); color: #c59c55; border: 1px solid #c59c55; padding: 16px 36px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(197,156,85,0.1); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Filter Tab
components.description: Minimalist category filter tab with gold active border indicator.
components.css: .ds-filter-tab { background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #4a3e28; padding: 18px 20px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-filter-tab:hover, .ds-filter-tab.active { color: #c59c55; border-bottom-color: #c59c55; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: 4:5 aspect ratio luxury product showcase stage with smooth hover zoom.
components.html:
LOUIS VUITTON
Twist PM Epi Leather
components.css: .ds-product-card { background: transparent; cursor: pointer; position: relative; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; } .ds-pc-img { aspect-ratio: 4/5; background: #0d0a05; overflow: hidden; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-pc-stage { width: 100%; height: 100%; transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(197,156,85,0.1) 0%, #0d0a05 80%); } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-pc-stage { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-pc-info { padding: 14px 2px 0; } .ds-pc-cat { font-size: 7.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.32em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6a5a38; margin-bottom: 5px; } .ds-pc-name { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: #d4c4a0; transition: color 0.25s; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-pc-name { color: #c59c55; }

narrative.overview: The visual language of Tiffany & Cris is grounded in high-end Parisian atelier aesthetics and intimate private showroom consultation. The palette emerges from deep obsidian blacks (#050403) layered with warm luminous golds (#c59c55) and champagne ivories (#f0e4cc), creating an evocative, museum-grade dark atmosphere that frames each handcrafted leather bag as a singular work of art.
keyCharacteristics: Atelier Obsidian Atmosphere: Atmospheric radial warm glows and fine grain textures on deep black canvas.
Editorial Contrast: High-drama scale variance between oversized editorial display headlines and micro-tracked labels.
Razor Sharp Geometry: Architectural zero-radius contours on cards and buttons evoking luxury packaging and bespoke leather gift boxes.
Tactile Transitions: Subdued, silky image zoom and micro-hover states that feel organic and heavyweight.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Champagne Gold (#c59c55) is reserved for high-intent actions, active navigation, and key accents. It must never coat large surface fills or overwhelm content.

rules.name: The No-Hard-White Rule
rules.body: True #ffffff is never used. All highlights and text rely on warm pearl and champagne tones (#f0e4cc, #e8dcc8) to preserve analog warmth.

rules.name: The Editorial Pairing Rule
rules.body: Headlines above 24px must use Cormorant Garamond. All navigation, metadata, specifications, and UI controls must use Montserrat in uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: Boundaries between surfaces are created via 1px low-opacity gold hairlines and subtle tonal shifts, never heavy solid borders or dark drop-shadows.

dos: Do maintain generous whitespace and deliberate padding around luxury bag photography.
Do format all metadata, categories, and buttons in uppercase with wide letter-spacing (≥ 0.22em).
Do use Cormorant Garamond italics selectively for evocative emphasis words (e.g. Collection, Private).
Do ensure all image stages maintain a consistent 4:5 aspect ratio.
donts: Don't use generic rounded corners (e.g. 8px, 16px) on product cards, inputs, or buttons; preserve the bespoke rectilinear silhouette.
Don't introduce high-saturation neon colors, cold blues, or synthetic purples.
Don't crowd the screen with automated checkout banners, countdown timers, or aggressive discount badges.
Don't use pure stark white (#ffffff) for typography; always use pearl/champagne tones.
